description.value: Max's Bakery & Deli is a neighbourhood institution on Oak Street that has been baking fresh bread, cakes, and pastries for Vancouver since 1949. The shop offers a full deli counter with ready-to-eat salads, sides, and hot daily specials, making it a solid spot for a touring cyclist to grab a substantial meal or stock up on baked goods. Catering and custom cakes are also available for events.
